notes: The catalogue provided lists no Arduino MKR 1000 WiFi entry, so it is added as a new part type with header-pin ports named after its labels (DAC0/A0 is named A0).
The parts list gives an 82 ohm resistor, but the diagram and schematic label it 220 ohm. I used the parts list value (82).
In the diagram the top half of the breadboard is labelled rows f-j. I mapped it to catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j), and the columns follow the diagram's numbering.

The resistor spans column 3 to column 6 in row h. The green wire from pin 2 goes to column 3 (row g). The LED's bent, longer leg (anode) is in column 6 and its straight leg (cathode) is in column 8. The black wire from GND goes to column 8.
The circuit matches the schematic: pin 2 to resistor to LED anode, then LED cathode to GND.
The sketch uses A1 only for an analogRead of a floating pin. No external part is wired to it.
